subject: Mutual action plan & decision timeline — Medallion Health
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@medallionhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-09T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed MPA and next steps

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (attached) so we’re aligned on milestones, owners and the decision path. Please confirm or flag edits.

Key pain points you highlighted:
- Production latency variability during peak batch jobs (p95 spikes >500ms).
- Unpredictable per-token costs with current provider; need clearer unit economics.
- Auditability and retention for PHI-like tokens (data residency + logs).

Goals we heard
- Pilot two models (conversation + summarization) behind a VPC endpoint.
- Maintain p95 <200ms for user-facing queries; acceptable batch throughput for nightly jobs.
- Production-grade audit logs and KMS integration; SOC 2 evidence.
- Decision to move to dedicated capacity by end of Q1 2028 if pilot success metrics hit.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (attached: Medallion-MPA-v1.pdf) — highlights
1) Pilot kickoff: target week of Jan 8, 2028 — Owner: Medallion (Samantha).
2) Integration & config: Redwood provides VPC onramp + security questionnaire completed by Nov 19 — Owner: Rishi / Redwood SE.
3) Canary run (2 weeks): success metrics (p95 <200ms, error rate <1%, cost per 1K tokens below threshold) — Owner: Medallion/Redwood ops.
4) Contract & procurement: finalize SOW and PO; target signed commitment by Mar 31, 2028 — Owner: Medallion procurement / Ben (Redwood).

Risks we called out and mitigations
- Data residency: we can run Private deployment or dedicated VPC with customer KMS.
- Cost variance: Redwood Optimize will produce a quantization/recommendation plan and expected unit cost delta.

Attachments included: Medallion-MPA-v1.pdf, SOW-draft.docx, security-questionnaire.xlsx (stub).

Requests from your side
- Please confirm primary legal/procurement contact (cc’ing here if possible).
- Confirm pilot kickoff window (Jan 8 or Jan 15).
- Any additional success metrics we should add to the MPA?

Next steps
- I’ll send the updated MPA and the security questionnaire completed by Nov 19.
- Ben will follow up on pricing and procurement path once we agree on timeline.

Thanks — look forward to moving this to a pilot.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[rishi.malhotra@redwood.com]
[Attachment: Medallion-MPA-v1.pdf (pdf, 48KB); SOW-draft.docx (docx, 35KB); security-questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB)]

Date: 2027-11-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed MPA and next steps

Hi Rishi —

Appreciate the clear summary — this matches our notes. A few quick items from our side:

1) Timeline: procurement is on a quarterly cadence; our target is to have a signed PO by Mar 31, 2028 as you noted. We’d like to begin the pilot in the week of Jan 15 (one week later than your earliest suggestion) to allow engineering prep.

2) Stakeholders: myself (buyer/ops), Kyle Park (legal — cc’d), Priya Shah (CTO) will be the technical sponsor. I’ll also loop Finance once we have an updated SOW.

3) Security/compliance: Legal will need SOC 2 Type II and answers to a short security questionnaire before pilot kickoff. Can you confirm you can share SOC 2 and fill the questionnaire by Nov 19?

4) MPA edits: please add a success metric for summarization accuracy (ROUGE-L > 0.45 or equivalent human sample pass). Also add a clause about data retention (30-day logs by default, longer if requested).

We’re comfortable proceeding with a two-week canary and then expanding if metrics are met. Once Kyle reviews the MPA, he may propose a small change to the liability language — he’ll let you know.

Thanks — I’ll review the attached MPA and get back with a single consolidated comment set by Nov 17.

Best,
Samantha Lowe
Director, Digital Product | Medallion Health
[email: samantha.lowe@medallionhealth.com]
